QuestInfo.name: The Girl's Birthday 3
QuestInfo.1: #bStands with Bulls#k wants to get his granddaughter a #rstorybook#k. Hunt down #rSinister Steel Masks#k near Twilight Perion to find 10 #bWar Journals#k for #bHard as Stone#k in the #brefuge#k.
QuestInfo.2: #bStands with Bulls#k wanted to get his granddaughter a #rstorybook#k. You hunted down #rSinister Steel Masks#k near Twilight Perion and found 10 #bWar Journals#k for #bHard as Stone#k in the #brefuge#k.

0.0: My granddaughter wants to hear more of my stories?
0.1: I remember those days... I used to tell her countless stories before #rthis town changed#k. I'd have her sitting on my lap while by the campfire, chit-chatting until she fell asleep. Good memories... *cough* *cough* *cough*.
0.2: But I can't leave here now. They'll never let me get to the refuge while I can still work... Oh, I should get her a #bstorybook#k!
0.3: There's a #bbook#k full of tales of Perion's greatest warriors, but we lost it when the #rmonsters#k attacked. Do you think you could find it for her?

yes.0: Thank you. I'd wager the #rSinister Steel Masks#k would have those #bWar Journals#k. Collect #b10#k of them for my \n#bgranddaughter#k, if you'd be so kind.

npc.0: Those #rSinister Steel Masks#k would most likely have the #bWar Journals#k we're looking for. Collect #b10#k of them for my #bgranddaughter#k.

item.0: I really want to #bhear my grandfather's stories again#k.
